targets.intended_property: Two rows with equal original-run identifiers and different campaign identifiers force the mathematical scan conflict flag, regardless of order or intervening rows.
targets.model_scope: All finite List ParsedRow values and all String values; both witnesses are members of the list. No packet eligibility or Python-source correspondence claimed.
targets.formal_definition: Sonification.Mat008.scan : List ParsedRow → State; conflict is a sticky Boolean and owner lookup uses the most recent association-list entry.
targets.main_theorem_exact_type:
∀ (rows : List Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow) (a b : Sonification.Mat008.ParsedRow),
  a ∈ rows →
    b ∈ rows → a.originalRun = b.originalRun → a.campaign ≠ b.campaign → (Sonification.Mat008.scan rows).conflict = true
assumptions: Lean kernel and distribution, verifier code, OS execution, and SHA-256 collision resistance are trusted.
ParsedRow fields are Lean Strings with exact equality; no Python parsing or real-world source authentication is modeled.
No project axiom, sorryAx, lcProof or lcUnreachable is accepted in the final theorem closure.
